integrity: The infinite characterization is proved directly from the canonical threshold creation blocks. Exhaustive enumeration through order 10 is used only as a regression check and not as a substitute for proof.
limitations: The theorem applies to finite connected threshold graphs and uniform open-neighborhood multiplicity requirements.
It does not address non-uniform total vector domination, weighted enumeration, or closed-neighborhood k-tuple domination.
Weakly indexed or differently named threshold-graph enumeration results could still overlap with special cases.
title: All \(k\)-tuple total dominating sets of connected threshold graphs
